verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents auto-renew controls, both across a portfolio (porkbun-docs-17) and per domain (porkbun-docs-39 shows turning auto-renew on for a specific domain). It also documents signed webhook notifications for upcoming expirations and renewals (porkbun-docs-8, porkbun-docs-33), plus programmatic renewal (porkbun-docs-1). Nothing in the pack covers grace or redemption windows for lapsed domains, so a third of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented grace/redemption periods and lapse-recovery process, email or dashboard expiry reminders beyond webhooks, independent or hands-on corroboration of renewal handling.
